question: Which of the following materials is preferably used in making heating elements of electrical heating devices?
solution:
The correct answer is '**__Nichrome__'** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nichrome:-**

 
 
• It is used for making the heating element of a
n electric iron.
 
• It has relatively **high resistance** and a **high melting poin**t.
 
• Nichrome is made of** 80% nickel**, **20% chromium**.
 
• Tungsten also has a high melting point and is used as the electrodes, heating elements and as filaments in light bulbs.
